Subject: Annual prepay: invoice cutover, PO approval & drawdown tracking

Hi Marta / ProcureOps team,

Following our call last week — attaching the proposed annual prepay activation plan and a sample invoice for Q2 to make sure the formats line up with your AP workflow. Two asks to keep the activation on schedule for June 1:

1) Can you confirm the PO number you will issue for the committed spend (attaching a stub: GreenHealth_PO_2027.pdf)? We need a PO to match the prepaid invoice for your ledger and to unblock our billing system.
2) We also need the VAT evidence attachment (company VAT registration + local tax rep) before we finalize the invoice. I attached a worksheet (VAT_evidence_request.xlsx) with the fields we need.

Operational notes:
- Redwood will issue one upfront invoice for the annual prepay and then provide a monthly drawdown register (CSV) that your AR team can match against consumption.
- If you prefer tranche invoicing instead of a single upfront invoice, let us know — we can phase into 3 tranches with milestone dates.

Next steps: if you can confirm PO number and upload VAT docs by EOD Thu (2027-05-05), we’ll route the DocuSign invoice and aim to have funds applied by 2027-05-15.

Attachments: GreenHealth_PO_2027.pdf, Redwood_Invoice_Sample_Q2.pdf, VAT_evidence_request.xlsx

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0142

Subject: Re: Annual prepay: invoice cutover, PO approval & drawdown tracking

Diego — thanks for the clear plan and the worksheet. Quick answers:

- We will issue a single PO for the annual commitment (PO# GH-2027-5561). I’m attaching the signed PO PDF from Procurement.
- VAT: our tax team needs to confirm a particular registration number variant (local branch vs HQ). I’ve started the request with them; they said they should be able to provide the VAT certificate and the company registration extract by Friday.

We’d prefer the single upfront invoice as you proposed; operationally it’s easier for our treasury team. Two coordination items for you:
1) Put the PO# GH-2027-5561 on the invoice header and in the invoice metadata field so our ERP can auto-match.
2) Can you include an explicit line in the invoice for the prepay allocation (e.g., "Committed spend prepay — Redwood Platform credits — 2027") so our GL maps to account 4201?

I’m looping in ProcureOps for AP-side confirmation.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement, GreenHealth
marta.ruiz@greenhealth.org

Attachment: GreenHealth_PO_2027_signed.pdf

Thanks Marta — Kimberly here from Redwood Finance. A couple of clarifications from our side to ensure your AP team can process without manual intervention: 

- We will place PO# GH-2027-5561 in both the PDF invoice header and the invoice metadata (electronic field). Please confirm whether your ERP expects the PO in the "Ref" field or the "ExternalRef" field; I can remap accordingly.
- For VAT evidence: our system needs the VAT certificate (PDF) and the VAT number as a plain-text field on the purchase record. If your registration uses a branch number (e.g., GH-12345-UK), please include both HQ and branch values. The VAT_evidence_request.xlsx lists the exact field names.

Operational proposal for drawdowns:
1) Redwood will send a monthly CSV (end of month) with consumption and remaining prepay balance; columns: invoice_date, consumption_tokens, unit_cost_usd, balance_usd, invoice_ref.
2) If you want automated matching, we can provide the CSV via a shared S3 bucket or a secured FTP. Which would you prefer?

Let us know and we’ll update the invoice template before routing for signature.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
